"''It's a long way.|The stormtrooper and "Orden"|}} A '''stormtrooper''' was active on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]] in [[9 BBY]].[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] is set ten [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' must be set in [[9 BBY]]. Taking a lift from [[Freck]] in the back of [[Freck's truck|his]] [[FMR-385 cargo speeder|mining repulsortruck]], he and his squad had a passing encounter with the farmer "Orden" and his daughter "Luma," in actuality the [[Jedi]] fugitive [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The [[stormtrooper]] first appeared in "[[Part III]]" the third episode of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]. Credited as "Stormtrooper #1" in the credits and "Stormtrooper 2" in the subtitles, he is portrayed by [[AJ Troup]]. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part III}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 3|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 3]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Stormtrooper non-identifié 1 (Camion de Mapuzo) |ka=უცნობი შტურმტრუპერი 1 (სატვირთო მაპუზოზე) }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
